        self.capacity = capacity
        self.rate = rate
        self.clock = clock
        self.tokens = capacity
        self.updated = clock()

        now = self.clock()
        self.tokens = min(self.capacity, self.tokens + (now - self.updated) * self.rate)
        self.updated = now

            self.tokens -= 1
